reading: Negotiations at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey remained in deadlock, with countries unable to agree even after discussions had overrun by more than a day.
The EU and Pacific island nations opposed the latest text because it omitted any reference to reducing global demand for fossil fuels.
A second sticking point concerned the African Group's request for stronger financial support for adaptation to climate impacts, which the EU had previously opposed.
Delegations moving their return flights from Sunday to Monday provided a further indication that agreement remained elusive.
Should countries fail to reach the required consensus, the negotiations could be suspended.
The summit could then end without agreement and be reconvened next year, an outcome with only one precedent since these climate meetings began in 1995.
Ministers sought to have a commitment to shift away from oil, gas and coal reinstated after fossil fuel producers led by Saudi Arabia pushed for its removal.
References to carbon capture, use and storage, a technology that stores released emissions underground, were criticised as a licence to continue burning oil and gas.
The proposed agreement could, for the first time at such a summit, acknowledge that the goal of keeping global temperature rise below 1.5C has been missed.
Australia's climate change and energy minister, Chris Bowen, resisted calls to include language on fossil fuels.
He argued that the summit should prioritise implementation, meaning putting measures into practice, and focus on the transition towards clean energy.
Meanwhile, renewable energy was expanding at unprecedented rates, with solar panels making the largest contribution to meeting new global energy demand that year and outstripping oil and gas.
One reported proposal would keep fossil fuels off the table in exchange for Saudi Arabia and other fossil fuel producers pledging to obtain 35% of their energy consumption from electricity by 2035.
An earlier objective of increasing adaptation funding to $120 billion by 2035 had been removed from the text.
Ghana's environment minister presented funding as a rightful claim on behalf of people bearing the brunt of developed countries' activities.
The departure of negotiating teams could also leave too few nations present to pass a global agreement.

vocabulary.definition: A situation in which opposing positions prevent those involved from reaching agreement.
A particular unresolved issue that obstructs a wider agreement.
Brought together again after a meeting has ended or been interrupted.
Restored to a document or position after previously being removed.
An apparent justification or permission to act, used critically here because the behaviour is considered harmful.
The process of putting an agreed policy or measure into practice.
Not previously experienced or recorded in the relevant context, here describing the rate of growth.
Exceeding something else in a particular measure, here the contribution to meeting new energy demand.
Excluded from the matters being considered or negotiated.
Experiencing the greatest share of something harmful or difficult.

entries.ja: 立場の対立によって、関係者が合意に達することができない状態。
entries.ko: 서로 대립하는 입장 때문에 관련된 사람들이 합의에 이르지 못하는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 因立场对立而使相关各方无法达成一致的局面。
entries.es: Situación en la que las posiciones enfrentadas impiden que las partes implicadas lleguen a un acuerdo.
entries.pt-BR: Situação em que posições opostas impedem as partes envolvidas de chegar a um acordo.
entries.fr: Situation dans laquelle des positions opposées empêchent les parties concernées de parvenir à un accord.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der gegensätzliche Positionen verhindern, dass sich die Beteiligten einigen.

entries.ja: より広い範囲での合意を妨げている、特定の未解決の問題。
entries.ko: 더 포괄적인 합의를 가로막는 특정한 미해결 쟁점.
entries.zh-Hans: 阻碍达成更广泛协议的某个尚未解决的问题。
entries.es: Cuestión concreta aún sin resolver que obstaculiza un acuerdo más amplio.
entries.pt-BR: Questão específica ainda não resolvida que dificulta chegar a um acordo mais amplo.
entries.fr: Question précise non résolue qui fait obstacle à un accord plus large.
entries.de: Eine bestimmte ungelöste Frage, die einer umfassenderen Einigung im Weg steht.

entries.ja: 会議が終了または中断した後に、再び集められたこと。
entries.ko: 회의가 끝나거나 중단된 뒤 다시 소집된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在会议结束或中断后被再次召集。
entries.es: Convocado de nuevo después de que una reunión haya terminado o se haya interrumpido.
entries.pt-BR: Reunido novamente depois que uma reunião terminou ou foi interrompida.
entries.fr: Réuni de nouveau après la fin ou l’interruption d’une réunion.
entries.de: Nach dem Ende oder der Unterbrechung einer Sitzung erneut zusammengebracht.

entries.ja: 以前に削除された後で文書に戻されたこと、または外された後で元の地位に戻されたこと。
entries.ko: 이전에 삭제되거나 해임된 뒤 문서에 다시 포함되거나 원래 지위로 복귀된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 先前被删除或撤去后，又被恢复到文件中或原有位置。
entries.es: Restaurado en un documento o en una posición después de haber sido eliminado o retirado.
entries.pt-BR: Restaurado em um documento ou em uma posição após ter sido removido.
entries.fr: Rétabli dans un document ou dans une position après en avoir été retiré.
entries.de: Nach vorheriger Entfernung wieder in ein Dokument aufgenommen oder in eine frühere Position eingesetzt.

entries.ja: ある行動を正当化したり許したりするように見えるもの。ここでは、その行動が有害と考えられているため、批判的な意味で使われている。
entries.ko: 어떤 행동을 정당화하는 듯한 이유나 그 행동을 허용하는 듯한 것. 여기서는 그 행동이 해롭다고 여겨지기 때문에 비판적인 의미로 쓰임.
entries.zh-Hans: 看似能为某种行为提供正当理由或许可的依据。此处带有批评意味，因为该行为被认为有害。
entries.es: Justificación o permiso aparente para actuar; aquí se usa con sentido crítico porque se considera que la conducta es perjudicial.
entries.pt-BR: Justificativa ou permissão aparente para agir; aqui, a expressão é usada de forma crítica porque o comportamento é considerado prejudicial.
entries.fr: Justification ou permission apparente d’agir, évoquée ici de manière critique parce que le comportement est considéré comme nuisible.
entries.de: Eine scheinbare Rechtfertigung oder Erlaubnis für ein Handeln; hier kritisch gemeint, weil dieses Verhalten als schädlich angesehen wird.

entries.ja: 合意された政策や対策を実行に移す過程。
entries.ko: 합의된 정책이나 조치를 실제로 실행에 옮기는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 将已商定的政策或措施付诸实践的过程。
entries.es: Proceso de poner en práctica una política o medida acordada.
entries.pt-BR: Processo de colocar em prática uma política ou medida acordada.
entries.fr: Processus consistant à mettre en pratique une politique ou une mesure convenue.
entries.de: Der Vorgang, eine vereinbarte politische Vorgabe oder Maßnahme in die Praxis umzusetzen.

entries.ja: その分野や状況で、それまでに経験されたことも記録されたこともないこと。ここでは成長の速さを表している。
entries.ko: 해당 상황이나 분야에서 이전에 경험되거나 기록된 적이 없는 상태. 여기서는 성장 속도를 설명함.
entries.zh-Hans: 在相关背景下，此前从未经历过或有过记录的；这里形容增长速度。
entries.es: Que no se había experimentado ni registrado antes en el contexto correspondiente; aquí describe el ritmo de crecimiento.
entries.pt-BR: Que nunca havia sido vivenciado ou registrado no contexto em questão; aqui, descreve o ritmo de crescimento.
entries.fr: Qui n’avait jamais été vécu ni enregistré auparavant dans le contexte concerné ; décrit ici le rythme de croissance.
entries.de: Im betreffenden Zusammenhang zuvor weder erlebt noch dokumentiert; hier auf die Wachstumsgeschwindigkeit bezogen.

entries.ja: ある基準で他のものを上回っていること。ここでは、新たなエネルギー需要を満たすための貢献の大きさを指す。
entries.ko: 특정 기준에서 다른 것을 넘어서고 있는 것. 여기서는 새로운 에너지 수요를 충족하는 데 기여하는 정도를 뜻함.
entries.zh-Hans: 在某一衡量标准上超过其他事物；这里指在满足新增能源需求方面的贡献更大。
entries.es: Superando a otra cosa según una medida concreta; aquí, la contribución a satisfacer la nueva demanda de energía.
entries.pt-BR: Superando outra coisa segundo um critério específico; aqui, a contribuição para atender à nova demanda de energia.
entries.fr: Dépassant autre chose selon un critère précis, ici la contribution à la satisfaction de la nouvelle demande d’énergie.
entries.de: Etwas anderes nach einem bestimmten Maßstab übertreffend; hier beim Beitrag zur Deckung des zusätzlichen Energiebedarfs.

entries.ja: 検討や交渉の対象となる事項から除外されていること。
entries.zh-Hans: 被排除在考虑或谈判的事项之外。
entries.es: Excluido de los asuntos que se están considerando o negociando.
entries.pt-BR: Excluído dos assuntos que estão sendo considerados ou negociados.
entries.fr: Exclu des questions examinées ou négociées.
entries.de: Von den Themen ausgeschlossen, die erwogen oder verhandelt werden.

entries.ja: 有害なことや困難なことによる影響を、最も大きく受けていること。
entries.ko: 해롭거나 어려운 일로 인한 영향을 가장 크게 겪고 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在有害或困难的情况下，承受最多的负面影响。
entries.es: Sufriendo la mayor parte de los efectos de algo perjudicial o difícil.
entries.pt-BR: Sofrendo a maior parte dos efeitos de algo prejudicial ou difícil.
entries.fr: Subissant la plus grande part des effets de quelque chose de nuisible ou de difficile.
entries.de: Den größten Teil der Belastungen durch etwas Schädliches oder Schwieriges tragend.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
